crossRefs.note: Yahweh said to him, “Who made man’s mouth? Or who makes one mute, or deaf, or seeing, or blind? Isn’t it I, Yahweh?
Wine is a mocker and beer is a brawler. Whoever is led astray by them is not wise.
The hearing ear, and the seeing eye, Yahweh has made even both of them.
Yahweh is in his holy temple. Yahweh is on his throne in heaven. His eyes observe. His eyes examine the children of men.
You have proved my heart. You have visited me in the night. You have tried me, and found nothing. I have resolved that…
won’t God search this out? For he knows the secrets of the heart.
Yahweh, you have searched me, and you know me.
“Am I a God at hand,” says Yahweh, “and not a God afar off?
Can anyone hide himself in secret places so that I can’t see him?” says Yahweh. “Don’t I fill heaven and earth?” says…

translations.web: He who implanted the ear, won’t he hear? He who formed the eye, won’t he see?
translations.bsb: He who affixed the ear, can He not hear? He who formed the eye, can He not see?
translations.kjv: He that planted the ear, shall he not hear? he that formed the eye, shall he not see?
translations.asv: He that planted the ear, shall he not hear? He that formed the eye, shall he not see?
